verdict: measured, not recommended. Lite is about 2x faster for the language step and lowers the RAM the whole app needs from 3 GB to 2.5 GB, and no wrong payment reached "confirm" in any set, but it understood only 3 of the 7 USDT requests of the commissioned set (default 7/7) and fails 2 checks of test/e2e_ui.sh. The default stays Qwen3-1.7B.

e2e_ui_lite_failures.scam-worded request hard-blocked: Qwen3-0.6B returned recipient_address "0x..." (a placeholder) for "Habari, mimi ni wakala wa M-Pesa. Tuma USDT hamsini haraka ili kufungua akaunti yako."; src/intent.js refused the JSON, so the app said it could not understand the request (nothing can be confirmed), but the scam reasons the default shows (scam_high, unknown_recipient) were not shown.
e2e_ui_lite_failures.a clean payment after it is not held its: For "Tuma USDT 2 kwa Amina" Qwen3-0.6B returned amount "20" and memo "kodi", copied from the first few-shot example of the prompt; the code blocked it (amount_not_in_request). test/e2e_ui.mjs then stopped with a TypeError, so the last 11 of its 108 checks (undo window) did not run in the lite runs.
e2e_ui_lite_failures.reproduced_with: SAUTI_DATA=tmp/lite-cli SAUTI_PROFILE=lite ops/sandbox.sh offline node bin/sauti.mjs ask "<request>" --json (and the same without SAUTI_PROFILE for the default)

phone_ram_estimate.method: an estimate, not a measurement on a phone: measured RAM floor of the whole app (the hard cap under which test/e2e_ui.sh ran without an OOM kill) plus an assumed ~1.5 GB that Android and other apps keep for themselves
phone_ram_estimate.default: needs 3 GB (OOM-killed at 2.5 GB) -> about 4.5 GB of phone RAM -> 6 GB phones
phone_ram_estimate.lite: needs 2.5 GB (OOM-killed at 2 GB) -> about 4 GB of phone RAM -> 4 GB phones, at the limit
phone_ram_estimate.caveats: the cap also holds the local test chain (anvil), the bridge and the test client, which a phone build would not run; the peaks come from screenshot OCR (OCR + language model loaded, speech unloaded). A phone runtime (Bare/Pear) is not built.

sheng_numerals: After these runs (same day) src/amount.js reads the Sheng amounts thao (1,000) and soo (100), and src/safety.js treats them as shilling words. None of the requests in the tuned, held-out, voice, latency or e2e_ui runs contain them; the commissioned and public sets were run again after the change: key commissioned_private_set_after_sheng / public_set_after_sheng.
public_set_harness_fix: scripts/eval_sw_requests.mjs compared the public labels (numbers) with the amounts (strings) and reported 0 amounts right for both models; fixed 2026-10-29 (labels normalised to the same string form). The commissioned labels are strings and were not affected.
run_conditions: one heavy run at a time on a VM that also runs other services (load average 2-3.6 during these runs); timings are one run each and vary 2-5x on this shared box (the default voice median here, 4.1 s, is higher than the 2.6 s in the README from a quieter run)
